name: Fighter
summary: A master of weapons and armor who fights in any style and keeps going with Second Wind and Action Surge.

recommended.note: Strength build for heavy armor and big weapons; swap Strength and Dexterity for an archer.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.summary: Gain a Fighting Style feat (Defense is recommended).
features.text: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. Each time you gain a Fighter level you can swap it for a different Fighting Style feat.

features.name: Second Wind
features.summary: Bonus Action: regain 1d10 + Fighter level Hit Points.
features.text: As a Bonus Action you regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level. You have two uses; one comes back on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest. More uses at levels 4 and 10.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.summary: Use the mastery properties of three kinds of Simple or Martial weapons.
features.text: Choose three kinds of Simple or Martial weapons; you can use their mastery properties. After a Long Rest you can swap one choice. You get more kinds at levels 4, 10 and 16.

features.name: Action Surge
features.summary: Once per rest, take one extra action (not Magic) on your turn.
features.text: On your turn you can take one additional action, which can't be the Magic action. One use per Short or Long Rest; from level 17, two uses but only one per turn.

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.summary: When you fail an ability check, spend Second Wind to add 1d10; kept if it still fails.
features.text: When you fail an ability check you can spend a use of Second Wind to roll 1d10 and add it to the check instead of healing. If the check still fails, the use isn't spent.

features.name: Fighter Subclass
features.summary: Choose a Fighter subclass.
features.text: You choose a Fighter subclass. From now on you gain each subclass feature when you reach its Fighter level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.summary: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.
features.text: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can attack twice instead of once.

features.name: Tactical Shift
features.summary: Using Second Wind lets you move half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
features.text: Whenever you use Second Wind as a Bonus Action, you can also move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Subclass Feature
features.summary: Gain a feature from your Fighter subclass.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Indomitable
features.summary: Reroll a failed saving throw with a bonus equal to your Fighter level.
features.text: When you fail a saving throw you can reroll it, adding your Fighter level, and must use the new roll. Once per Long Rest; twice from level 13 and three times from level 17.

features.name: Tactical Master
features.summary: Swap a weapon's mastery property for Push, Sap or Slow on an attack.
features.text: When you attack with a weapon whose mastery property you can use, you can use Push, Sap or Slow for that attack instead.

features.name: Subclass Feature
features.summary: Gain a feature from your Fighter subclass.

features.name: Two Extra Attacks
features.summary: Attack three times when you take the Attack action.
features.text: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can attack three times instead of once.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Indomitable (two uses)
features.summary: Indomitable works twice per Long Rest.

features.name: Studied Attacks
features.summary: After missing a creature, Advantage on your next attack against it before the end of your next turn.
features.text: If you miss a creature with an attack roll, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against it before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat (+2 to one ability or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20) or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet.

features.name: Action Surge (two uses)
features.summary: Action Surge works twice per rest, once per turn.

features.name: Indomitable (three uses)
features.summary: Indomitable works three times per Long Rest.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.summary: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for.
features.text: Take an Epic Boon feat or any other feat whose prerequisites you meet. Boon of Combat Prowess is recommended.

features.name: Three Extra Attacks
features.summary: Attack four times when you take the Attack action.
features.text: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can attack four times instead of once.
